messages:
Dana Soto: hi all, day1 brain dump 1) who owns alerting for feature-store and embeddings infra? 2) who approves network/VPC egress for partner integrations? 3) where's the single org chart for quick pings?
Ethan Moore: welcome Dana! feature-store alerts are ops-owned (eng-sre) and embeddings infra is eng-ml infra. for partner egress, people-ops + security sign the contract and eng-platform does the network work.
Dana Soto: do you have direct contacts for those teams? trying to avoid the loop.
Jin Park: sure  eng-sre lead is @Jin Park, eng-ml infra is @Ethan Moore, security reviewer is @People-Ops (security lane). I'll DM both.
People-Ops: automation: vault/contract notes: use the "Partner Access + Egress" template. Required fields: partner_name, data_scope, duration, legal_contact. People-Ops will route to Security and Legal.
Dana Soto: perfect. also, where's the org chart bookmark? want to know who to page for emergent DB reads.
Ethan Moore: bookmark /org/contact-matrix. it lists primary owners, backfills, and PagerDuty aliases. DB emergency page goes to infra-oncall -> eng-sre.
Dana Soto: pager: is it `infra-oncall@pagerduty`? and how fast do I expect a response?
Eng-Oncall: automation: yes, infra-oncall@pagerduty. Response SLA: 15m initial ack weekdays. weekend coverage is oncall->lead->director. For DB escalations mark severity in ticket.
Dana Soto: sweet. one more 1) laptop asset tag to IT for VPN? 2) where to request a buddy for product walkthroughs?
IT Desk: please DM your asset tag to IT Desk ASAP. VPN provisioning sometimes blocks remote devs for 24-48 hours if missing.
People-Ops: buddy program info: /new-hires/buddy-assignments. ping us in #new-hires and we'll match you with a buddy from your team.
Dana Soto: thanks folks. I'll file the partner template if needed and join the buddy program. tagging checklist: 1) bookmark org/contact-matrix, 2) file Partner Access if relevant, 3) DM IT with asset tag, 4) ask People-Ops for buddy.
Jin Park: one last tip: if you need emergency DB read access during an incident, file "Emergency Access" with "timeboxed: 2h" and put eng-sre on the approval line for fast-track.
Dana Soto: noted. filing a couple of tickets now, will post links. appreciate the quick help :thumbsup:
